command: PYTHONPATH=backend POSTGRES_DB=bardi_issue119_repair_probe uv run python tools/measure_service_scoped_snapshot.py --scales 0,100,500 --settings bardi.settings.test --facts '{"application_location":"inside_egypt"}' --evaluation-date 2026-12-31
dataset: The probe creates one requested published graph, one unrelated published graph, one unrelated authoring-draft graph, and then scale unrelated published and draft graphs. Each generated published graph has one evidence anchor with two discrepancy-transition rows (open and resolved) and two repeated semantic-preserving re-verification events. Draft graphs have the same catalog/evidence shape but are excluded by published/withdrawn validation filters. All generated rows are removed after each scale in the disposable database.
limitations: Elapsed values are single-run observations on a local disposable PostgreSQL 17 instance, not a capacity benchmark or query-count-only performance claim.

The deterministic workload uses two discrepancy transitions and two repeated reviews per generated unrelated published anchor; validation reports every event row and one unique workflow owner row per anchor.
The scoped loader retains the complete Fact registry and global validation-only ledger; its row-linear global validation work is reported rather than hidden.
Detached rows count eagerly materialized domain records and nested provenance references. Global-validation rows and workflow rows are database row accounting, not detached object counts.

The generated graph is deterministic and includes published and draft catalog/evidence growth plus repeated unrelated workflow history, but it is synthetic and not an imported production-family workload.

The script uses production publication for generated published graphs, disables only aggregate immutability guards while deleting its own namespaced rows, and vacuums/analyzes after each scale; run it only in the documented disposable database and drop that database afterward.
Full/scoped response equality uses the supplied facts, locale, and evaluation date and records only the boolean result, not response contents.
